$schema_note: Every measurement the Hypnerotomachia states, converted to metres. Hand-written 2026-09-08 by the scale research pass; NOT generated, and no script rewrites it. Prose version and reasoning: DIMENSIONS.md. Companions: DIRECTIONS.md, WOODS.md.

units_to_metres.note: Dallington's printed gloss on p. 27 — 'A furlong is 16. pole euery pole being 16 foote' — is wrong. Every 'furlong' in Dallington renders Colonna's stadio and is 185 m, not 78 m. Bury 1998 converts it this way throughout.

measurements.thing: span between the cliffs, = width of the pyramid's base storey
measurements.note: Dallington p. 26 reads 'sixe furlongs, and twelue paces'. The Italian governs.

measurements.stated: derived: the lateral edge equals the base side, so each face is equilateral and h = s / sqrt(2)
measurements.note: Bury instead deduces 3275 ft (969 m) from the 1410 steps and flags it as a deduction. Build to 785 m: it is what Colonna's own stated construction produces.

ground to the nymph's feet, total
the gyrating bronze nymph on the obelisk
measurements.stated: colossal, yet reads as life-size from the ground
measurements.note: OURS, NOT COLONNA'S. For a figure 865 m up to subtend the angle a 1.7 m person subtends at 25 m. Offered as a target; marked inference.

measurements.thing: the four-square court before the porch, diameter
the winged horse, into the court from its mouth, toward the gate
measurements.note: Corrected 2026-09-09; the id was horse-from-porch and the reading was 'from the porch', which is the far end of the court from where the book puts him. Dallington's 'in the passage towardes the Porche, some tenne paces' is ambiguous in English; the 1499 is not — 'Sopra di questa piacia, dal'initio intro verso la porta x passi' — from the piazza's BEGINNING inward toward the gate. The court runs z 70.4 to 26, so he is built at z 55.6. DECISIONS.md call 51.
Climbed by the beard to the breast, entered by the mouth and down the throat.

measurements.thing: the brass altar between the dwarf columns
Cupid's six-oar: gunwale curvature / thwarts above the decking

measurements.stated: one mile plus 2/11 of a partition, by Colonna's own pi = 3 + 2/11

measurements.note: Exactly one sixth of the diameter; three of them make the radius.

measurements.thing: cypresses on the shore rim, spacing
the shorn myrtle wall behind them
the citrus espalier dividing the rings
the twenty gates in the lattices
the middle ring's meadows / the paths between
measurements.note: The meadows narrow toward the centre — Colonna's own 'illegitimate squares'.
Agrees with p. 325's '16 paces from middle to centre'. Already near-true in the world — exempt it from any global rescale.
